original.target_description: Experiment 3: inward versus outward implied-motion adaptation; within-participant difference in perceived null-motion points in normalized dot coherence; two-tailed paired t test, t(28)=4.98.

n.sample_role: Participants in Experiment 3 paired adaptation analysis; established from 32 enrolled minus 3 explicitly excluded, corroborated by t(28).
n.exclusions: Three Experiment 3 participants excluded for poor baseline motion-sensitivity performance (normalized coherence would exceed 100% dot coherence).
n.location: Published pp. 278–280 (PDF pp. 3–5), Participants and Equipment; Subject Exclusion; Results.
n.quote:
All subjects (26, 19, and 32 for Experiments 1–3, respectively) ... periment, 1 subject from the second experiment, and 3 subjects

es.location: Published p. 280 (PDF p. 5), Results, right column, third-experiment paragraph; normalized coherence.

p.location: Published p. 280 (PDF p. 5), Results, right column, third-experiment paragraph; same normalized-coherence t(28)=4.98 test.

notes: Published article version, exact title/authors verified on supplied canonical text. Rendered PDF pages 3–5 inspected. No manuscript or embedded appendix substituted. Canonical text renders equals signs as "5" and plus/minus as U+0006; exact quote glyphs retained. Rendered page 5 confirms t(28) = 4.98 and p = .000 for normalized coherence. The separately printed actual-coherence test is t(28) = 5.48, p = .000; not combined with the selected test. Analytic n=29 is established by the explicit 32-person Experiment 3 sample and three exclusions, not printed as a standalone total; t(28) and the debriefing accounting of 24 respondents plus 5 nonrespondents corroborate it. Printed p=.000 retained as an equality without reinterpreting its precision. Unassigned replication and narrative-success fields intentionally left unavailable.
